correctness.rationale: Using the exact result definitions, Kemeny score plus sum of Kendall inversions equals 6 times electorate size for any ranking, and maximin support plus worst opposition equals electorate size. Independently implemented subset-DP optimal ranking scores and minimum pairwise supports for every 24^1+24^2+24^3 strict labeled four-candidate profile. Counts: all 24 and 576 small-voter profiles agree; at three voters 12,768 equal and 1,056 strict Kemeny subsets of maximin (cells (1,3)=144,(1,4)=576,(3,4)=336); eight candidate/voter orbits seven of size144 and one size48. This independent DP differs from the package verifier’s direct rank enumeration; the package script and RESULT.md were inspected. Published 3-candidate equality supplies the separate minimal-candidate premise. The finite universe here is exhaustive, not a sample.
